searchText: We've changed now the prices to DATALOAD 4 and DATALOADN 3 gas EOF call in 1.5 hours https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/873 I updated the list of EOF open questions here https://notes.ethereum.org/@ipsilon/rk7ryK_Ja btw <@275684146658148352> i think the separate forward/backward stack validation rules is the approach used by wasm (i remember reading this, but can't find the reference now) some discussion on whether wasm's validation rules could have been better: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=12848620 **EOF Implementers Call 24** https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZCAmkVpKDIQ One item we didn't discuss on the call: "Make data section optional again" - I think any zero length section should be optional as a rule. And we have a rule that code_size may not be zero independent of that rule. That also sets expectation for future sections.
